text: Noah flies to Lisbon on Friday for a week. He's never been and wants restaurant tips, so remind me to send him that list from my trip.
Lunch with Meera today. She's gone fully vegan since September and says she feels much better for it. Her sister Yasmin is still trying to convert her back to cheese.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday and renew the car insurance by June 3rd.
Varun is allergic to sesame, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering when we do the team dinner next Tuesday.
Tiago and his wife are off to Brazil on May 14 to see her family in Recife. Eleven-hour flight with two toddlers, he sounded exhausted just thinking about it.
Siobhan only drinks oat flat whites. No sugar.
Called Mum. Uncle Kwame's knee operation went well on Monday and he's already complaining about the hospital food. I should ring him at the weekend to see how he's getting on.
Joe's trip to Japan is off. His company froze all travel until next year, so he's gutted.
Kiara mentioned she'd love a decent coffee grinder. Her birthday is 7/22, so that's sorted.
Need to book the boiler service, return the library books and buy stamps. Ideally all before the weekend.
Wiremu is back from New Zealand tomorrow. Three weeks visiting his grandparents in Rotorua. Must ask him how his nan is doing, she had a fall in the spring.
Grace has been diagnosed coeliac. She's finding it really hard, especially eating out. Her partner Luis is doing all the cooking for now.
Dalia and Björn are celebrating ten years married on August 9th. They're doing a long weekend in Copenhagen with his parents minding the kids.
Dentist moved to Wednesday at 4:30.
Hoang hates coriander. Says it tastes like soap. Also doesn't drink at all, so get him something decent and non-alcoholic for the barbecue.

Spoke to Georgia after the meeting. Her flight to Toronto got cancelled twice last week and she finally landed on Sunday. Her luggage is still somewhere in Frankfurt. She's there until November 2nd for her cousin's wedding and has had to buy a whole new outfit for it. Remind me to message her on Monday to check the bag turned up.
Don't forget to text Isaac good luck for his interview on Thursday morning. He's really nervous about the presentation part.
Zoe's dog Biscuit is having a lump removed on 10/28. She's worried sick even though the vet says it's routine.
I'm driving to the airport for 6am on Saturday, so pack Friday night and leave the keys with next door.
Angela is doing Dry January in October, apparently. Something about a bet with her brother Carlos. He's only made it four days.

Duc's parents are visiting from Hanoi for a month, arriving next Wednesday. He's been deep cleaning the flat all week and is slightly panicking about cooking for his mum, who apparently judges everyone's broth. His dad is diabetic, so no sweet stuff either. They're also hoping to do a few days in Scotland while they're here, probably the weekend after next.
Remind me to ask Suzanne how the cruise went. She got back on Monday and I didn't get a chance to talk to her properly.
Tunde only eats halal, and he's off fish completely at the moment.

Xavier and Laura have just booked their honeymoon: two weeks in Bali starting June 20th. The wedding itself is the Saturday before. Need to get the gift off the registry this week before the good stuff goes.
Anders's daughter starts university in Edinburgh in a fortnight. He's driving her up on the Saturday and then flying back alone, which I think he's dreading more than he admits.
Quick one: Kiri prefers red wine, Malbec especially. Not white.
Aarav has a three-hour layover in Doha on the way to Melbourne. Told him to try the lounge.
Rohan's mum has been in hospital since Friday with pneumonia. He's flying out to Mumbai tomorrow night. I must check in with him over the weekend, and maybe send something to the family.
Giulia's brother Isaac is getting married in Florence on September 12th. The whole family is going over for a week, and she's in charge of the hen do.
Cancel the gym membership before the 30th. They charge again on November 1st.
Meera said Yasmin is pregnant! Due in March. Very early days so they're keeping it quiet.
Noah came back from Lisbon raving about the custard tarts. He's now trying to make them at home and has ruined three batches.
Varun is nervous about his citizenship test next Monday. He's been revising on the train every morning. I should send him a message on Sunday evening, just to say good luck.
Siobhan's husband Duc is lactose intolerant, which I had completely forgotten. Pick up oat milk before they come round on Friday.

Kwame told me his retirement party is on the 15th, a Friday, at the cricket club. He's finally finishing after thirty-one years at the council. His wife Angela is planning a surprise slideshow, so don't mention it to him. Must get a card and get everyone in the office to sign it by the Wednesday before.
Georgia's sister Kiara keeps dropping hints about a pasta machine. Christmas sorted.
Joe said the stag in Prague has been called off. The groom's dad isn't well, so they're doing a quiet night locally instead.

Long call with Tiago this evening. His visa interview at the consulate is November 4th and he's been stressing about it for weeks because the paperwork keeps changing. If it goes through, they'll move to Porto in the new year, and his wife already has a job lined up there. He's also trying to learn Portuguese properly, as in the European kind, which he says is harder than it sounds. Remember to ask him how the interview went that afternoon.

Isaac has started keto. Two weeks in, says he misses bread more than he misses people. His girlfriend Zoe is doing it with him for moral support, although she admitted to a secret croissant on Tuesday. He's aiming to stick with it until his holiday in Crete on July 4th.
Groceries for the week, then the post office. Also need to sort my passport renewal, it expires in May.
Dalia told me her grandmother passed away last Thursday. The funeral is in Beirut, so she's flying out on Sunday with her mum.

Mrs Santos next door is going to Madeira for a fortnight from Tuesday. I said I'd water her plants and feed the cat, Pepper, who only eats the expensive pouches. Her husband is staying behind because of work, but he's away most weekdays. Key is under the blue pot. She's back on the 9th, a Saturday.
Remind me to ask Grace whether she found that gluten-free bakery in Shoreditch.
Bumped into Wiremu and his partner Kiri at the market. They're both training for the Auckland half marathon on 3/15 and have cut out alcohol until then. Kiri is the more competitive one.
Hoang got the job at the hospital! Starts on October 27. He sounded so relieved, he'd been applying since summer.
Anders is a huge whisky person. Islay, peaty, the smokier the better.
Aarav's flight to Melbourne was delayed by nine hours and he missed his connection. He's finally there now but slept in Doha airport.

Zoe and her boyfriend Carlos broke up over the weekend. The trip to Mexico they had booked for December is obviously off now. She seemed okay but I think she's putting on a brave face. Her mum is flying over from Dublin on Friday to stay for a bit, which should help. I should take her out for dinner next week, somewhere vegetarian since she's given up meat again.

Booked the train to Manchester for Thursday the 23rd. Still need to print the tickets, sort a hotel near Piccadilly and find someone to take the parcel in if it comes on the Friday. Also cancel the Thursday yoga class and move my haircut to next Saturday.
Laura is doing a cookery course in Bologna in the spring. She's been talking about it for years.
Spoke to Suzanne. Her son Rohan is moving to Dubai for work on May 2nd. She's proud but obviously sad about it, and she's already planning a visit at Christmas.
Angela can't have any nuts at all, including coconut. She mentioned it twice tonight so it clearly matters.
Don't forget to call Tunde tomorrow to see how his dad's scan went.
Need to get Euros before the trip, and check whether the travel insurance covers skiing.
Xavier has a fear of flying and is dreading the long haul to Sydney next month. He's thinking about doing one of those courses before he goes.
Giulia's little boy Noah turns five on Saturday. She wants something to do with dinosaurs, nothing noisy.

Lovely evening with Meera, Varun and Joe. Varun is hosting a Diwali dinner on November 8th and asked everyone to bring a dessert. Meera is doing gulab jamun because she can't help herself. Joe is threatening to bring a shop-bought trifle again. I'll make the pistachio cake and should ask Varun if anyone else is coeliac apart from his cousin.
Björn is in Stockholm until next Wednesday. His dad's seventieth is on the Sunday.
Remember to move the bins out Tuesday night.
Duc mentioned he's been feeling really low since moving here. Misses his family and the food, mostly the food. I need to invite him over for pho on Sunday, or at least find a good place nearby.
